quote: This project is not just about creating a greenway; it is about creating access to local businesses and connecting the tourism center of Downtown Pensacola to the culturally rich neighborhoods of Brownsville and Warrington. The Bluffline project will stimulate local economic development and breathe new life into an area that was once thriving retail corridors.
author: Lumon J. May
title: Commissioner, District 3
organization: Escambia County Board of County Commissioners
